text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Daaang... Well, gotta keep your chin up,
right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: No, no, no. It's really not a big deal!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If it were easy, arcades would go out of
business.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it. Why don't we grab
some
ramen on the way home?
